sources.excerpt: Funny enough, I didn't know how to scream. Whenever I met [Curry and] everybody, I was in a really shy place in my life... Feels great... It's dopamine. / an audition high is when um you can feel the energy change in the room, and you have this split second of either getting too much in your head or feeling a high off of it. And then you kind of let that feed you / I've always wanted to do film, and I love film, and I'm very thankful for Superman & Lois cuz it gave me my start... I got freedom. And last minute we decided to change be like no she's a final girl she wouldn't do that she's going to sit with the grief and also at the same time we're following her this entire time. Curry was like no we really we were we want to sit with her and that's why we got the ending that we did and so that day we decided to change it and so it just again kind of going back to that that quickness of flipping um just allowing yourself in that exact moment to have that freedom

A week later she gave her reason to Kyle Buchanan (S42 30:48-31:31, C138): "Exposure was something that I really wanted to avoid... I was a very sensitive person at the time. And that prejudgment... would have killed me and that would have killed Nikki." So the withholding was itself protective, not a sign of indifference to safety. It does narrow the "used Curry as a mirror... full trust" story (C23): her trust was staged, not blanket. Draft stage: the base.en transcript of the Awards Chatter audio (S41, ~44:48) has "before going in I had told Curry I'm really sorry but I'm not going to show you any of the freakouts in rehearsal and I think I saw him die"; THR's excerpt edits "I had told" to "I told".
